title: Silver Top Taxi Service Limited - proposed acquisition of Murrell Enterprises Pty Ltd trading as Bay City Cabs (BCC)
targets: Murrell Enterprises Pty Ltd trading as Bay City Cabs (BCC)

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commence
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed  acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Silver Top Taxi Service Limited - Proposed acquisition of certain assets from Murrell Enterprises Pty Ltd and joint venture arrangement with Geelong Radio Cabs Cooperative Limited (STTS's proposed transaction).
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets in its assessment of the proposed transaction: - An east coast market for the provision of dispatch services; - Markets for the provision of taxi depot services to taxi licence holders/ operators licensed in the Geelong or Bellarine or Torquay taxi zones (Markets for the provision of taxi depot services); and - Markets for the provision of taxi hire services by taxi licence holders/ operators to the public in Geelong, Bellarine and Torquay (Markets for the provision of taxi hire services).
body_sections.Competition analysis: In reaching its conclusion not to oppose STTS's proposed transaction, the ACCC took into account, amongst other factors: - Efficiencies resulting from access to state-of-the-art dispatch services, improved economies of scale in the provision of taxi depot services and the provision of taxi hire services in Geelong; - Availability of substitutes for the provision of dispatch services; - Moderately low barriers to entry for entry into the Geelong market for the provision of taxi depot services; - No market concentration increases in the Bellarine and Torquay markets for taxi depot services and the Bellarine and Torquay taxi hire services; and - The regulation of the provision of taxi hire services in Geelong including pricing is the responsibility of the Victorian Taxi Directorate.
